title: A certified input extends a lower bound for qubit-channel capacity
summary: An AI-assisted search found a 45-qubit input with positive coherent information at per-Pauli error probability 0.064966. The author used the prior certifier unchanged, extending the earlier certified point of 0.064956. This gives a lower bound for where the depolarizing channel can transmit quantum information.
ai_technology: Claude Sonnet 5.5; Infinity Machine research agent

source_review.scope: Zenodo v1 exact-certificate deposit and metadata; Infinity Machine §3.2 and Appendix A.1; prior certified bound

evidence.tested: Exact arithmetic enclosed coherent information between 2.31 and 2.78 × 10⁻⁸ bits. The total Pauli error probability is three times the per-Pauli probability.
evidence.unknown: The bound applies to the supplied input. The optimal threshold is unknown, and the cited author check does not establish independent confirmation.
evidence.ai_role: Claude Sonnet 5.5 wrote and ran an optimizer starting with an earlier witness. The human operator supplied the task, seed and verification tools.
